notes: POLICY: install resolves @latest, vets that exact version with dependency-vetter, and installs ONLY on PASS. This file is the fallback + floor, not a fixed target.
knownGoodVersion is the most recent version a human vetted. If @latest fails its vet, fall back to this version (vet it too before installing). Never install below it.
No preinstall/install/postinstall scripts declared in the vetted version.
npm audit against 1.5.0 reports 0 advisories (info/low/moderate/high/critical all 0).
Zero runtime dependencies; ships prebuilt native binaries per platform via optionalDependencies (codegraph-<platform>-<arch>).
Ships anonymous usage telemetry, on by default. Disable with `codegraph telemetry off` after install.
A self-update command `codegraph upgrade` exists. Do NOT tell users to run it — updates go through the vet, not around it.
The `codegraph install` subcommand registers an MCP server into agent configs. The pack does not use it; orc talks to the CLI. See README for the opt-in MCP path.
